items.title: Hackers Hijack ConnectWise ScreenConnect to Deploy SCKit Malware Across 288 Devices at 48 Organizations
items.description: Attackers have taken over cloud-hosted ScreenConnect panels and used them to push a custom toolkit called SCKit to at least 288 managed devices across 48 organizations. Security firm Huntress first saw the activity on November 11, 2026, and says all 288 hosts were hit within about 90 minutes. items.title: Node.js Fixes 16 Security Flaws That Could Expose TLS Private Keys and Crash Servers Remotely
items.description: The Node.js project has released fixes for 16 security flaws across its 22.x, 24.x and 26.x lines. Seven are rated high, six medium, and three low. The official advisory says the patched builds are v22.23.5, v24.22.3 and v26.13.1. The update also refreshes three bundled parts: llhttp, undici, and sqlite. items.title: Chinese AI Project Scouts Spies in Taiwan Chip Industry
items.description: The CCP built a Big Data system to scrape reams of information and learn about individuals abroad, to potentially target and exploit them. Think Alice Huang Lite.

items.title: Japan Pushes Emergency Funding for Cybersecurity as AI-Assisted Breaches Rise
items.description: The package adds public-private cyber responders, an AI-focused team run by the economic ministry, and more leeway to use the government's new active cyber-defense powers.
